verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no export feature and no open-format dump, so there is no first-party way to take all your data out and leave. Server-side `copy_from_namespace` copies only into another turbopuffer namespace. Query pagination and dashboard browsing are building blocks a developer could use to script an export, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
